The '''Freeport Security Force''' was a private law enforcement group chartered with the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] to enforce local laws and protect the citizenry. It consisted of approximately 150 [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]].<ref name="Game" />

Since they were contractors, the FSF officers were not known to be particularly brave or effective. Most of their arrests were minor infractions, and they stuck close to the [[Historic District]], since that's where the wealthy citizens were.<ref name="Game" />
